description: Web 搜索与抓取（自 commands/web.rs 拆出，kernel-plugin-runtime Phase 1 续批）

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the internet for real-time information. Uses a free anonymous search API first; if it fails, automatically falls back to Bing/DuckDuckGo scraping. No API key required.

maxResults.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 10)

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its text content. HTML pages are reduced to readable text (scripts, styles, tags stripped). JSON / plain text / markdown pass through verbatim. Use to read documentation, API responses, or source files hosted on the web. 15s timeout, 1 MiB max.

url.description: The URL to fetch (HTTPS or HTTP only)
